name: manual_b74cec
claim: Scope the backup to what matters and never rm -rf: of a 3.7 GB ~/.alphaclaw only about 5 MB is real config; the rest is regenerable (plugin-runtime-deps 1.2 GB of old openclaw runtimes, the npm cache 878 MB, lib/node_modules 502 MB, node_modules 972 MB). Keep the full checksummed archive until the update succeeds, add a slim archive that excludes those folders (19 MB), and move obsolete runtimes to the Trash instead of deleting them. A .ckignore exception is added per exact file by the operator (the single gateway log), and a variable assignment such as L=path is parsed by the hook as the path, so use the literal approved path.

decisions.notes: Backup and cleanup on 2026-11-25 before the clean gateway cutover.

rationale: Backup and cleanup on 2026-11-25 before the clean gateway cutover.
